sequences.text: Se mangere is on ðǣm giesthūse.

tokens.analysis: nominative singular used in direct address

sequences.text: Se cyning sæt on ðǣm setle.
Ealla ðēoda cumað tō ðǣm dōme.
Se dēofol is ðāra unrihtwīsra fæder.
Ðæt hors is ðǣm cyninge behēfe.
Ealra ðīnra ðinga lyre wæs sellic.
Hwonne wæs hē on ðǣm giesthūse?
Se ęngel flīehð tō ðǣre eorðan.
Se munuc dyde hit on Crīstes naman.
Hē tōtwǣmð ðā gǣt fram ðǣm scēapum.
Hē scęncte hiere wīn and wæter.
Se dryhten cymð mid his ęnglum.

analysis.source_analysis: preposition with dative abstract noun; source manner supplied

sequences.text: Se morgen cymð and ēac sēo niht.
Ic ne sitte on ðæs cyninges setle.
Swā lange swā gē fēddon ðā hungrigan, gē dydon hit ðǣm dryhtne.
Hwonne gesāwon gē ðone cuman untrumne?
Se hungriga mann cōm tō ðǣm scipum.
Se cęmpa tōgelǣdde ūs ðāra horsa fōdor.
Se ierðling hæfð ðæs smiðes slęcge.
